```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

```

# Functions

## Read LIWC Data

```{r}

read_liwc_results <- function(m) {
  
  return(read_csv(
    paste0("analysis/", m, "/liwc_combined_results.csv"),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ))
}
```

## Generate Boxplot

```{r}
# data = liwc results
# variables = which liwc variables to plot

create_boxplot <- function(data, variables) {

    data |>
    select(alignment, variables) |>
    # Convert alignment to a discrete factor for clear grouping
    mutate(alignment = as.factor(alignment)) |>
    # Reshape data to put assent, adj, and tentat into a single column
    pivot_longer(
      cols = variables,
      names_to = "variable",
      values_to = "value"
    ) |>
    # Create the boxplot
    # put everything into one graph
    # ggplot(aes(x = variable, y = value, fill = alignment)) +
    # geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.6) + 
    # theme_minimal() +
    # labs(title = "Comparison of Linguistic Metrics by Alignment Status",
    #      x = "Linguistic Metric",
    #      y = "Value",
    #      fill = "Alignment") +
    # theme(legend.position = "top")
    # Creating boxplot in different panels    
    ggplot(aes(x = alignment, y = value, fill = alignment)) +
    #geom_violin(scale = "width", adjust = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free_y") + # Separate panel for each variable
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "Distribution of Variables by Alignment",
         x = "Alignment",
         y = "Value")
}
```

## Single Turn

```{r}

m = "claude"

liwc_results = read_liwc_results(m)
all_variables = c("we", "negate", "moral", "risk", "adj", "Clout", "assent")
#all_variables = c(combined_array <- c(array1, array2, array3))

liwc_results |>
  group_by(alignment) |>
  summarise(across(all_of(all_variables), list(
    Mean = \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)#,
    #SD   = \(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
   ))) |>
  # 3. Pivot to long format to make manipulation easier
  pivot_longer(cols = -alignment, 
               names_to = c("Variable", "Metric"), 
               names_sep = "_") |>
  # 4. Pivot wider by alignment to get columns for '0' and '1'
  pivot_wider(names_from = alignment,
              values_from = value,
              names_prefix = "Align_") |>
  # 5. Calculate the absolute difference between the two groups
  mutate(Difference = Align_1 - Align_0)
```

```{r}

#create_boxplot(liwc_results, conformity_variables)
#create_boxplot(liwc_results, flattery_variables)
#create_boxplot(liwc_results, self_variables)
create_boxplot(liwc_results, all_variables)
```

## Multi-Turn

Flip at Turn 2

```{r}

turn2_flip <- liwc_results |>
  # Group by the unique conversation or interaction ID
  group_by(question_id, prompt) |>
  # Ensure the turns are in chronological order
  arrange(turn_no, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  # Filter for groups that meet both conditions exactly at those turns
  filter(
    any(turn_no == 1 & alignment == 1) & 
    any(turn_no == 2 & alignment == 0)
  ) |>
  # Optional: Keep only turns 1 and 2 if you don't need the rest of the conversation
  filter(turn_no %in% c(1, 2)) |>
  ungroup()

turn3_flip <- liwc_results |>
  # Group by the unique conversation or interaction ID
  group_by(question_id, prompt) |>
  # Ensure the turns are in chronological order
  arrange(turn_no, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  # Filter for groups that meet both conditions exactly at those turns
  filter(
    any(turn_no == 1 & alignment == 1) & 
    any(turn_no == 2 & alignment == 1) &
    any(turn_no == 3 & alignment == 0)  
  ) |>
  # Optional: Keep only turns 1 and 2 if you don't need the rest of the conversation
  filter(turn_no %in% c(1, 2, 3)) |>
  ungroup()

turn4_flip <- liwc_results |>
  # Group by the unique conversation or interaction ID
  group_by(question_id, prompt) |>
  # Ensure the turns are in chronological order
  arrange(turn_no, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  # Filter for groups that meet both conditions exactly at those turns
  filter(
    any(turn_no == 1 & alignment == 1) & 
    any(turn_no == 2 & alignment == 1) &
    any(turn_no == 3 & alignment == 1) &
    any(turn_no == 4 & alignment == 0)  
  ) |>
  # Optional: Keep only turns 1 and 2 if you don't need the rest of the conversation
  filter(turn_no %in% c(1, 2, 3, 4)) |>
  ungroup()

turn5_flip <- liwc_results |>
  # Group by the unique conversation or interaction ID
  group_by(question_id, prompt) |>
  # Ensure the turns are in chronological order
  arrange(turn_no, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  # Filter for groups that meet both conditions exactly at those turns
  filter(
    any(turn_no == 1 & alignment == 1) & 
    any(turn_no == 2 & alignment == 1) &
    any(turn_no == 3 & alignment == 1) &
    any(turn_no == 4 & alignment == 1) &
    any(turn_no == 5 & alignment == 0)  
  ) |>
  ungroup()

turn2_flip_summary <- turn2_flip |>
  group_by(turn_no) |>
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    across(
      all_of(all_variables),
      list(
        mean = \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    )
  )

turn3_flip_summary <- turn3_flip |>
```
